GPA, GRE, acceptance rate, and FT MBA cohort size are not published ('average class size 26' on Fast Facts is school-wide, not the FT MBA cohort). Tuition: the official 2026-2027 Gabelli graduate tuition page at https://www.fordham.edu/student-financial-services/tuition-and-payments/graduate-tuition/gabelli-school-of-business/ prices the Cohort (Full-Time) MBA as a total program cost, 133949 for entrants Fall 2026 and later (129107 prior to Fall 2026), 4 payments over 2 years, plus a one-time 9133 enrichment fee; no annual tuition figure is published, so tuition_usd left null. Salary: no current official employment report with a median; the school's 2022 outcomes page cites an average, not a median. fordham.edu pages required following a CAS gateway redirect; fetched successfully with cookies this session.
